title: Pyramids in the Elysium region

tellings.quote: probes photographed huge pyramids some 500 M High some with four sides just like the Great Pyramids of Giza

plain: Space probes are said to have photographed huge pyramids in the Elysium region of Mars, some around 500 meters high and some with four sides, "just like the Great Pyramids of Giza." Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode with the psychic spy Joe McMoneagle about life on Mars. It is told because such shapes would hint that someone once built on Mars.
